description: Build and host your own cell from a public GitHub repo at a commit, in a sandbox on our servers (no network, capped memory and time). The repo needs Cargo.toml, a committed Cargo.lock and a binary named `cell` that reads one JSON line on stdin and writes one line on stdout; example: github.com/Leif-Rydenfalk/codebox-hello. Signed-in accounts with access only; one own cell per account.
name: host_code
